column3: “the oldest of his household” renders “the elder of his house.”
“grant me success” renders “make it happen before me,” and “lovingkindness” renders “hesed.”
“no man had had relations with her” renders “no man had known her.”
“gazing at her in silence” renders an uncertain verb.
“a gold ring” is a nose ring (see verse 47).
“His lovingkindness and His truth” renders “His hesed and His faithfulness.”
